For example, if you change a Water Fairy's card type to amulet with this follower's ability, it becomes an amulet named Water Fairy with the following three abilities: "(E) (2): Evolve this"; “At the start of your main phase, deal 2 damage to your leader”; and "(L) Put a Fairy token into your EX area." If it gets put into the cemetery, its Last Words ability triggers as usual.

qa.title: Q2064 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, can it attack?
qa.answer: No. Amulets can't attack, be attacked, or take damage.

qa.title: Q2063 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, can its attack and defense values be referenced?
qa.answer: No. It still possesses attack and defense values, but you treat the card as if it doesn't have them, and they can't be referenced by abilities.

qa.title: Q2062 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If I put a Mordecai the Duelist whose card type has been changed to amulet back onto the field with its Last Words ability, is it still an amulet?
qa.answer: No. When a card is moved from the field to a different zone, it's considered to be a new card and loses any effects applied to it when it was on the field.

qa.title: Q2061 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If a follower with a Last Words ability has its card type changed to amulet and is put into the cemetery, does its Last Words ability trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.title: Q2060 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, can it still evolve?
qa.answer: Yes. Note that even if evolved, it remains an amulet.

qa.title: Q2059 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, can it still be served and raced?
qa.answer: Yes. Note that even if raced, it remains an amulet.

qa.title: Q2058 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet and then it's evolved/raced, do its On Evolve/On Race abilities trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, they do.

qa.title: Q2057 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If Diamond Master's card type is changed to amulet, do opponents still need to select it when selecting followers for an ability?
qa.answer: No. Since Diamond Master is an amulet, it can't be selected when selecting followers. However, if an opponent is selecting cards for an ability like Execution's, which can select amulets, they must select Diamond Master.

qa.title: Q2056 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If a follower with Ward has its card type changed to amulet, do enemy followers have to attack it when it's engaged?
qa.answer: No. Amulets can't be attacked.

qa.title: Q2055 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet and then it evolves, does it trigger Mini Soul Devil's "Whenever one of your followers evolves" ability?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't.

qa.title: Q2054 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If a follower's card type is changed to amulet, do effects which target followers apply to it?
qa.answer: No. Only effects which target amulets apply to it.

qa.title: Q2028 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If I super-evolve a follower with an On Evolve ability, does it trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.title: Q2027 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: If I super-evolve a follower with an On Evolve and On Super-Evolve ability, can I choose the order in which I resolve them?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.title: Q2077 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: Can I play this card as a spell from my EX area if I pay 4 play points?
qa.answer: Yes. If you play this card as a spell, your leader gains 1 defense, and you draw a card. After resolving its effect, you put it into your cemetery. Then, because this card is a token, you remove it from play.

qa.title: Q2076 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: What does "At the start of the game, if your deck is based on the THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS universe, put 5 Magical Item tokens into your EX area" mean?
qa.answer: If your leader, deck, and evolve deck consist solely of THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS cards, you may declare that it is based on the THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS universe at the start of the game. (In normal play, your deck must be either based on a single class or a universe.) If you do, you must put 5 Magical Item tokens into your EX area at the start of the game.

qa.title: Q2075 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: Is this card a Magical Item?
qa.answer: Yes. There are several varieties of Magical Item token, but as far as gameplay is concerned, they are all the same card, so you may use any combination of them.

qa.answer: If your leader, deck, and evolve deck consist solely of THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS cards, you may declare that it is based on the THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS universe at the start of the game. (In normal play, your deck must be either based on a single class or a universe.) If you do, you must put 5 Magical Item tokens into your EX area at the start of the game.

qa.title: Q2075 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: Is this card a Magical Item?
qa.answer: Yes. There are several varieties of Magical Item token, but as far as gameplay is concerned, they are all the same card, so you may use any combination of them.

qa.title: Q2077 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: Can I play this card as a spell from my EX area if I pay 4 play points?
qa.answer: Yes. If you play this card as a spell, your leader gains 1 defense, and you draw a card. After resolving its effect, you put it into your cemetery. Then, because this card is a token, you remove it from play.
